description: Return actual seat listings for one event — section, row, quantity, seat range, base and all-in price per ticket, listing notes, and fee detail — cheapest all-in first. Use after search_events when the user wants seat options to choose from, not just a starting price. max_price caps the ALL-IN price per ticket (fees included); min_quantity keeps only listings with at least that many tickets together. quantity is a filter only, not a reservation or hold. IMPORTANT: always relay each option's notes to the buyer before recommending it — notes carry critical facts (obstructed or limited view, behind-stage seats, parking-only passes that do not include admission, mobile-entry requirements, and delivery dates). Notes pass through verbatim and must never be summarized away. Purchase still happens through the event page link (url) — this tool does not transact.

max_price.description: Hard cap in USD on the ALL-IN price per ticket (fees included)

min_quantity.description: Minimum tickets together in one listing (default 1)

sort.description: Sort order: "cheapest" (default, lowest all-in first). "best_value" is not available yet.

name: get_seat_options
